If, instead, one obtained I|g normalization by requiring that |S(I(|g+ce) to g.s.)=100, a value of 1.02 {I9} would be obtained, in excellent agreement with the normalization recommended by 1967Mo05. The ratio R=I|g(2007ChZX, 'Budapest data')/I|g(1967Mo05) varies widely but, if cases where the intensities differ by at least a factor of 3 are removed from consideration, the average value of R is 0.93 for secondary lines and 1.10 for primary transitions. Some, but not all, of the inconsistencies may stem from the poorer energy resolution of the 2007ChZX measurement or from the presence of unidentified impurities. For the strong 116.8|g, 136.7|g, 5181|g, 5212|g and 5813|g, I|g(2007ChZX)/I|g(1967Mo05) is 0.83 {I9}, 0.85 {I10}, 0.95 {I9}, 1.04 {I11} and 0.93 {I8}, respectively. With the adopted normalization, the total observed primary |g intensity is 16%.
